findings: Current first-party NextCharge surface confirms connector/station tariffs are exposed in the app and charging/payment can be performed through NextCharge; NextCharge is also an interoperable eMSP, so app pricing cannot be assumed to equal direct GES-CPO pricing for every IT*GES EVSE.
Exact IT*GES connector IDs are used by the NextCharge flow/QR convention, providing a deterministic join key for a future backend/guest extraction.
Current evidence remains heterogeneous by host/operator; no safe network-wide or power-class tariff for the 2,402 current PUN GES EVSE is proven.
antiRepeat: Do not repeat broad web tariff searches. Resume only from an exact NextCharge guest/app/backend payload keyed by IT*GES EVSE/connector, QR/payment surface, or new first-party CPO tariff evidence. Keep roaming/eMSP tariffs separate from direct GES CPO pricing.
blockingCondition: Exact NextCharge guest/app/backend connector payload or QR/payment surface proving the direct CPO tariff for each IT*GES EVSE; do not substitute NextCharge roaming/eMSP pricing.
